source_caption_text:
​Three days after walking out of court a free man, Tampa rapper Billy "Ace" Adams did the unthinkable. 🚨 
​In January 2023, Adams beat a double murder charge claiming self-defense. Just 72 hours later, police say he lured 22-year-old Alana Sims—who was 5 months pregnant—to a quiet subdivision under the premise of a "victory party". 
​Instead of a party, Alana was executed in the street while her 1-year-old toddler slept unharmed in the back seat. Adams' defense when caught? Self-defense. Again. 
​Now, after being convicted of murder, Adams took a piece of notebook paper and wrote a handwritten letter directly to the judge: 
​"I do not want my lawyers presenting any mitigation. Give me what the jury voted for. I have no issue with the death penalty."
​Is this genuine remorse, or one last attempt to control the narrative? Drop your thoughts below 👇
